en: Sepia Romanian postal card with a printed stamp and address fields. The photo shows the arched brick fortification known as the city bastion in Timișoara, with pedestrian paths, a road with vehicles, and 1960s–70s apartment blocks in the background. Caption beneath the image identifies the site. Top right reads 'CARTE POȘTALĂ' with a pre-printed 'ROMANIA / POSTA ROMANA / 30 BANI' stamp.
